options.denominator: Not applicable; count of pedestrians killed, not a rate
options.reason: Annual totals directly answer how many pedestrians were killed in each requested calendar year.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the requested year-by-year number by summing the recorded pedestrian fatalities across crashes in each calendar year; the bars show the annual totals for 2013–2025. A sum is defensible because the question asks how many people were killed, rather than a rate or share. It does not break totals down by borough, time, or crash characteristics. No rows in the included years are left out because crash_date or number_of_pedestrians_killed is NULL (0% in each included year), and none of the included years is partial in this file; years outside 2013–2025 are outside the requested period.
